paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: Paper constrains both ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) couplings using a 3He/39K SERF comagnetometer (NASDUCK-SERF). The proton coupling result is highlighted as the first reliable terrestrial bound on ALP-proton. The hint suggested AxionNeutron but the paper equally/primarily emphasizes the novel proton bound; coupling type is therefore ambiguous between AxionProton and AxionNeutron, lowering confidence. Mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. Numerical limits not given as a table in the text; the precise tabulated bounds are in an external GitHub repository [57]. Data points listed are approximate readings from Fig. 2 and text (e.g. gaPP partially closes 5e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1). 95% C.L. Detailed per-mass values not extractable from the provided content.
